node: Uranium conversion, enrichment, HALEU production, and advanced nuclear fuel supply
summary: Layer 1B expansion finds that the cleanest public exposure to the HALEU/enrichment bottleneck remains Centrus, while the less obvious discovery lane now includes Solstice Advanced Materials as a newly public conversion-capacity owner/operator exposure, Lightbridge as a small-cap advanced-fuel technology option, and ASP Isotopes as a speculative laser-enrichment/HALEU shadow candidate. The main chokepoint insight is that mining exposure is not equivalent to conversion, enrichment, HALEU production, or advanced fuel fabrication exposure; several investable links are either hidden in larger diversified companies, newly spun off, or still technologically unproven.
